findings.passage: This is simple. This is common sense. This is not partisan. This is absolutely what Californians demand from all walks of life, from all geographical areas, from all wealth classes and certainly from all parties. So we look forward to getting this on the ballot. Congratulations to the hard work of the men and women that got this there, and let’s get it across the finish line in November.
findings.note: Quoted by The San Joaquin Valley Sun at a Fresno rally for the California Voter ID initiative (rally held 2026-03-03 per ABC30). She speaks about the initiative that would require ID to vote and verify voter lists.

findings.motion: Listed as CA Voter ID Regional Co-Chair at a Visalia signature-gathering event for the voter ID initiative
findings.note: Event page lists her as regional co-chair of the voter ID initiative campaign, for an event held in Visalia on 2025-10-25.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: do pass and re-refer to Judiciary (failed 2-5); also voted aye on reconsideration (failed 2-5)
findings.note: AB 25, California Voter ID and Election Integrity Act of 2025, would require voter ID and documentary proof of citizenship to register. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. She voted aye both times; the bill then died in committee.

findings.motion: Assembly Elections Committee: do pass as amended and re-refer to Appropriations
findings.note: AB 1116 (Berman), voter registration, would let people register online without a California driver license or state ID by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. She voted no.
subjects: voter registration without a state ID
